transforms.rule: Exact original value; no trim/case-fold, no default overwrite; check target encoding/length/nullability first.
Preserve user/credential IDs when compatible; other entity IDs use frozen logical-source + table + canonical PK + projection-role map, not snapshot/random/time; never Number-roundtrip BIGINT.
Preserve original state and use an exhaustive reviewed mapping; unknown/NULL unexpected state blocks; never grant role or reactivate deleted users.
Copy DECIMAL(20,8) as exact decimal text; preserve original per-user amount and reference, never float/zero-default.
Resolve exact parent map and original relationship role; preserve original key bytes; no implicit merge, ID coercion or owner-based history leakage.
Copy SHA-256 token hash exactly with original user/revocation facts as credential_version=3; do not generate a token or a V4 session during backfill.
Preserve raw DATETIME lexical value and precision; candidate +08 writers are evidence only until historical coverage is frozen; unknown time blocks UTC projection.
Preserve unsigned integer millisecond string and range-check before UTC DATETIME(3) derivation; no local timezone adjustment.
Preserve source-column facts under a controlled row receipt / encrypted snapshot locator; no operational replay; historical content remains subject to original user/account access.
Keep original runtime fact as historical evidence; obtain active installation/profile/epoch/online state only from a newly authenticated real connection after cutover.
Preserve source and audience policy exactly; channel→source→account mapping; never convert source operator into administrator or trade owner.

gaps.summary: 旧 DATETIME 逐列历史写入版本/时区证据未冻结；保留原墙钟，不统一减8小时。
验证、登录方式、Telegram、偏好等活动字段缺承接DDL及读写合同。
会员来源/周期/推荐码/推荐余额缺活动承接；不从plan推算付费连接额度。
账户实体归一、currency来源、用户账户状态分离和稳定legacy映射需冻结。
现有复合PK不能保存重复归属区间；需追加区间历史并约束历史访问。
账户读取依赖真实档案/binding INNER JOIN；不得伪造安装标识来显示离线账户。
观摩source、audience、默认/排序和授权读模型缺完整承接。
受控逐行历史/加密归档定位、receipt和领域读取适配尚未实现。
验证挑战与一次性配对不恢复为有效授权；认证切换/重新验证流程待专项验收。
保留V3 token_hash和撤销事实；不得预造V4设备绑定；迁移读取和授权回归待验收。
终端连接、在线状态、心跳、epoch不得从备份恢复成当前真实连接。
